lead.label: 3j
lead.why: Abstract: 'Phenyl 2-acetamido-3-(4-fluorophenyl)propanoate was identified as the selective and most potent inhibitor of BChE.'

reactions.conditions: Acid 1 equiv, phenol 1.1 equiv, Et3N 1 equiv, DMAP 0.1 equiv in DCM (7 mL), EDC 1.5 equiv added in one portion, rt overnight; wash, crystallise from n-hexane. Yield 98%.
reactions.source: Section 4.1.2.2 (general ester procedure) and compound 3j data, main text pp. 18-22; 'commercially available N-acetyl-o/m/p-fluorophenylalanines 1-3' in section 2.1

notes: Racemic (N-acetyl-DL-FPhe), so no stereochemistry drawn. The acid name is derived from the text 'N-acetyl-2/3/4-fluorophenylalanine (1, 2 or 3)' (3 = 4-fluoro); no systematic name printed for the acid.
